import subprocess,pathlib,hashlib,json,datetime
base='f2692089ad4259808e27d9b7e882ac09505b180a'
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); out=root/'audits/2026-10-11-n45-s-long-s-direct'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/'logs').mkdir(); (out/'frozen').mkdir()
paths=['docs/HANDOFF.md','docs/STATUS.md','docs/c5_excess_two_nonadjacent_unit_core45.md','audits/2026-10-10-n45-s-long-contract/REPORT.md','audits/2026-10-10-n45-s-long-r-map/REPORT.md','docs/c5_degree5_interfaces.md','docs/c5_no_spoke_exterior.md','docs/c5_single_spoke_cores.md','docs/c5_single_spoke_three_one.md','scripts/c5_degree5_interfaces.py','scripts/c5_no_spoke_exterior.py','scripts/c5_single_spoke_cores.py','scripts/c5_single_spoke_three_one.py']
records=[]
for p in paths:
    raw=(root/p).read_bytes()
    b=subprocess.run(['git','show',base+':'+p],capture_output=True)
    if b.returncode or b.stdout!=raw:
        finding={'path':p,'exit_code':b.returncode,'stderr':b.stderr.decode(),'worktree_matches_base':b.stdout==raw}
        (out/'SOURCE-MISMATCH.json').write_text(json.dumps(finding,indent=2)+'\n')
        raise SystemExit('SOURCE MISMATCH '+p)
    blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',base+':'+p],text=True).strip()
    dst=out/'frozen'/p; dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with dst.open('xb') as f: f.write(raw)
    records.append({'path':p,'git_blob':blob,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'frozen_path':str(dst.relative_to(out)),'worktree_matches_base':True})
with (out/'input-records-v1.json').open('x') as f: json.dump({'task_id':'N45-S-LONG-S-DIRECT','base':base,'head_at_freeze':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'inputs':records},f,indent=2); f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'frozen','base':base,'paths':len(records),'all_worktree_bytes_match_base':True}))
